sloka: शराभिघातसंरब्धः सो ऽपि जग्राह सायकान् ।काकुत्स्थः सुमहातेजा युगान्तादित्यतेजसः ।। ६.१०५.८ ।।
transliteration: śarābhighātasaṁrabdhaḥ so 'pi jagrāha sāyakān ।kākutsthaḥ sumahātejā yugāntādityatejasaḥ ।। 6.105.8 ।।

translations.english: Endowed with extraordinary energy, Kakuthsa, angered by the impact of arrows resembled the Sun at the end of universal dissolution, took up arrows.
